page: Amazon Web Services g4dn.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading. The CPU operates at 2.5 GHz and is supported by 32.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz. Graphics and parallel computing workloads are handled by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU from the Turing architecture family, equipped with 16 GB of VRAM. Additionally, the instance includes 225 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between CPU-bound tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the weak to average categories. Similarly, compression and decompression tasks show lower relative performance. However, the system excels in machine learning inference. LLM inference speeds for prompt processing using small and medium models rank in the top tier, while text generation for these models is strong. Memory bandwidth and database operations, such as Redis SET, perform at average levels.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the g4dn.2xlarge offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated tasks without the high cost of larger multi-GPU systems. The integration of local NVMe SSD storage and dedicated CPU resources makes it suitable for workloads that require a mix of local data caching and parallel processing. This instance is best suited for small to medium machine learning inference, graphics-intensive applications, video transcoding, and database operations that benefit from GPU acceleration and fast local storage.
description: Amazon Web Services g4dn.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for graphics-intensive and machine learning workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of DDR4 memory, it features a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Storage is provided by a 225 GB local NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is rated at a 10 Gbps baseline. While general CPU benchmarks and single-threaded operations perform in the lower to average tiers, the instance delivers top-tier performance in LLM inference prompt processing and strong text generation speeds for small and medium models. This hardware profile makes the g4dn.2xlarge highly efficient for small-scale machine learning deployment, graphics rendering, and database operations requiring local NVMe caching.
